{
  "title": "Structured Query Language (DDL/DML/DCL)",
  "description": "An 8-week intermediate course for university students covering the core components of SQL, including Data Definition, Data Manipulation, and Data Control Languages, based on the COMPANY database schema.",
  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Week 1: Introduction to SQL and Database Definition",
      "topics": [
        "What is SQL? (Structured Query Language)",
        "The Three Core Languages of SQL: DDL, DML, and DCL",
        "Understanding Schema and Catalog Concepts",
        "Introduction to Data Definition Language (DDL)",
        "Creating Tables with CREATE TABLE",
        "SQL Basic Data Types (Numeric, Character, Date-Time)",
        "Using Domains to Define Custom Data Types"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Week 2: Defining Constraints and Table Structures",
      "topics": [
        "Specifying Constraints: An Overview",
        "Key Constraints: PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE",
        "Referential Integrity: FOREIGN KEY and Triggered Actions",
        "Attribute Constraints: NOT NULL, DEFAULT, CHECK",
        "Tuple-Based Constraints with CHECK",
        "Modifying Table Structures with ALTER TABLE",
        "Removing Database Objects with DROP",
        "Practical Exercise: Creating the COMPANY Database Tables"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Week 3: Basic Data Retrieval with SELECT",
      "topics": [
        "Introduction to Data Manipulation Language (DML)",
        "The Basic SELECT...FROM...WHERE Statement",
        "Retrieving Data from a Single Table (Projection and Selection)",
        "Retrieving Data from Multiple Tables (Basic Joins)",
        "Using Aliases for Tables and Columns",
        "Handling Ambiguous Attribute Names",
        "Using the Asterisk (*) and Unspecified WHERE Clause",
        "Eliminating Duplicates with DISTINCT"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Week 4: Advanced Selection and Set Operations",
      "topics": [
        "Set Operations: UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT",
        "Pattern Matching with LIKE",
        "Using Arithmetic Operators in Queries",
        "Understanding NULL and Three-Valued Logic",
        "Nested Queries (Subqueries) with IN",
        "Correlated Nested Queries",
        "The EXISTS and UNIQUE Functions",
        "Comparison Operators: ANY, SOME, and ALL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Week 5: Joins, Aggregation, and Grouping",
      "topics": [
        "Explicit JOIN Syntax in the FROM Clause",
        "INNER JOIN vs. NATURAL JOIN",
        "OUTER JOINS: LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL",
        "Aggregate Functions: COUNT, SUM, MAX, MIN, AVG",
        "Grouping Results with GROUP BY",
        "Filtering Groups with HAVING",
        "Sorting Query Results with ORDER BY",
        "Review: The Complete SELECT Statement Structure"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Week 6: Data Modification and Views",
      "topics": [
        "Adding Data with INSERT INTO",
        "Inserting Multiple Rows from a Query Result",
        "Modifying Data with UPDATE",
        "Removing Data with DELETE",
        "Introduction to Views: Creating Virtual Tables with CREATE VIEW",
        "Querying and Dropping Views",
        "Updatable Views and the WITH CHECK OPTION Clause"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Week 7: Data Control and Advanced Concepts",
      "topics": [
        "Introduction to Data Control Language (DCL)",
        "Granting Privileges with GRANT",
        "Propagating Privileges with WITH GRANT OPTION",
        "Revoking Privileges with REVOKE",
        "Case Study: Managing User Permissions",
        "Advanced Constraints: CREATE ASSERTION",
        "Introduction to Triggers (Conceptual)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Week 8: Course Review and Final Project",
      "topics": [
        "Course Summary and Key Takeaways",
        "DDL Practice: Comprehensive Table Creation",
        "DML Practice: Complex Queries and Subqueries",
        "Views Practice: Creating and Using Views for Data Analysis",
        "Final Assessment: Query, Update, and View Challenges"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
